arguments.code:
token = access_token
# find album Echo Chamber Chronicles from earlier search results (res_all)
album = [a for a in res_all if a.get('title')=='Echo Chamber Chronicles'][0]
album_id = album['album_id']
song_ids = album['song_ids']
print('album_id', album_id)
print('song_ids', song_ids)

song_stats=[]
for sid in song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    # show_song schema includes play_count
    song_stats.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': s['title'], 'artist': s['artists'][0]['name'], 'play_count': s.get('play_count')})
print('song_stats', song_stats)
# compute least listened
least = min(song_stats, key=lambda x: x['play_count'])
print('least', least)
